title: Learning Robust Social Strategies with Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2511.19405v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As agentic AI becomes more widespread, agents with distinct and possibly conflicting goals will interact in complex ways. These multi-agent interactions pose a fundamental challenge, particularly in social dilemmas, where agents' individual incentives can undermine collective welfare. While reinforcement learning (RL) has been effective for aligning large language models (LLMs) in the single-agent regime, prior small-network results suggest that standard RL in multi-agent settings often converges to defecting, self-interested policies. We show the same effect in LLMs: despite cooperative priors, RL-trained LLM agents develop opportunistic behavior that can exploit even advanced closed-source models. To address this tendency of RL to converge to poor equilibria, we adapt a recent opponent-learning awareness algorithm, Advantage Alignment, to fine-tune LLMs toward multi-agent cooperation and non-exploitability. translated_title: 使用大语言模型学习鲁棒的社会策略
translated_abstract: 随着智能体AI的日益普及，具有不同且可能相互冲突目标的智能体将以复杂的方式进行交互。这些多智能体交互带来了一个根本性挑战，尤其是在社会困境中，智能体的个体激励可能会损害集体福利。虽然强化学习（RL）在单智能体场景中已能有效对齐大语言模型（LLM），但先前基于小型网络的研究结果表明，多智能体环境中的标准强化学习往往会收敛到背叛性的、自利的策略。我们在LLM中证实了同样的效应：尽管模型具有合作先验，经RL训练的LLM智能体仍会发展出机会主义行为，甚至能够利用先进的闭源模型。为了解决RL收敛到不良均衡的这一倾向，我们采用了一种近期的对手学习感知算法——优势对齐——来微调LLM，使其趋向多智能体合作与不可被利用性。随后我们引入了一个分组……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文揭示了强化学习微调会使大语言模型智能体在社会困境中产生可利用的机会主义背叛行为，并提出将“优势对齐”算法适配于LLM微调，使模型学会鲁棒且不可被利用的多智能体合作策略。
